Inside the target file, the only repetition is the integrability term `integrable_finsetSum s (fun i _ => (shell_energy_integrable (τ i) N).const_mul _)`, which appears twice in one proof. That is too small to report on its own. The real repetition is in FalconerCompletion/Measures/AssemblyPositiveEnergy.lean. Its lines 27–52 are verbatim copies of this file's norm_weighted_sum_sq_le and charFun_weighted_sum under new names. Its assemblyPositiveEnergy_weighted_sum (lines 54–74) repeats the whole mixture-energy argument of shellEnergy_weighted_sum_le / shellEnergy_weighted_sum_uniform; the only difference is the integration set, `Icc (R/2) (2*R)` instead of `dyadicShell N`. I checked that nothing under OAI/MeasureTheory/Falconer imports FalconerCompletion, so AssemblyPositiveEnergy can import ShellMixtures without creating a cycle. The Assembly file already opens `PlanarFalconer`. Remaining uncertainty: I could not compile anything. Whether `shellEnergy` unfolds by `exact` or needs an explicit `unfold shellEnergy` is unverified. The finite-measure instance for the mixture `∑ c i • τ i` is already used implicitly at line 50 of the target, so the shared lemma needs it in the same way.

findings.problem: The mixture-energy argument is written out twice, once in this file and once in AssemblyPositiveEnergy.lean. It goes: rewrite the mixture's charFun as a weighted sum, apply the pointwise weighted Cauchy–Schwarz bound, use integral_mono, then integral_finsetSum and integral_const_mul. The two copies differ only in the integration set, `dyadicShell N` here and `Icc (R/2) (2*R)` there. The Assembly file also copies this file's two helper lemmas verbatim under new names (assembly_norm_weighted_sum_sq_le, assembly_charFun_weighted_sum). The result is three duplicated proofs that have to be maintained separately.
findings.proposed_change:
Add a set-generic lemma to ShellMixtures.lean, stated for any compact set:

theorem setIntegral_charFun_weighted_sum_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℝ≥0)
    (τ : ι → Measure ℝ) [∀ i, IsFiniteMeasure (τ i)] {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hc : (∑ i ∈ s, (c i : ℝ)) ≤ 1) :
    ∫ r in S, ‖charFun (∑ i ∈ s, c i • τ i) r‖^2 ≤
      ∑ i ∈ s, (c i : ℝ) * ∫ r in S, ‖charFun (τ i) r‖^2

Proof sketch: use the current body of shellEnergy_weighted_sum_le, replacing `shell_energy_integrable μ N` with `(continuous_charFun.norm.pow 2).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hS`. That is the same term Shells.lean and assemblyEnergy_integrable already use. Then:

• Here: `theorem shellEnergy_weighted_sum_le ... := by unfold shellEnergy; exact setIntegral_charFun_weighted_sum_le s c τ (dyadicShell_compact N) hc`.

• In AssemblyPositiveEnergy.lean, add `import OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Shells.ShellMixtures` (no cycle, because nothing under Falconer imports FalconerCompletion). Delete assembly_norm_weighted_sum_sq_le and assembly_charFun_weighted_sum, and use charFun_weighted_sum in assemblyPositiveEnergy_sum. Start assemblyPositiveEnergy_weighted_sum with `(setIntegral_charFun_weighted_sum_le s c τ isCompact_Icc hc).trans` and keep only its last three calc steps (the `∑ c i * C ≤ C` bound). Alternatively, also generalise shellEnergy_weighted_sum_uniform to the set form and call it on both sides.
findings.benefit: There would be one statement of the convex-mixture energy bound for squared characteristic functions, parametrised by the integration set, instead of three copies. The Assembly proof drops about 45 lines of copied reasoning. A reader sees that both energies obey the same lemma. Any fix to the argument, such as an API rename of integral_finsetSum or integral_smul_nnreal_measure, is made in one place. The degenerate cases are unchanged: an empty `s` and zero weights are covered by the same proof.
